svg.desc: Prerequisite arrows point toward dependent issues. Layers are derived, not approved dates. Labels and border patterns distinguish completed, current, upcoming, closed and blocked work. Every node links to its live issue; Markdown provides full titles, prerequisites and unlocks.
svg.text: Derived layers; not deadlines or acceptance.
Blocked overrides fill/border; current keeps double.

a.aria-label: EVE-35: Keep a long agent run from blocking its entity's other messages. UPCOMING. Captured Linear: Backlog. 2026-11-17T15:45:43.910Z: later-status: Bounded live description and terminal comment-page review retains Backlog. Slice 3 adds a single-attempt under-1000-ms authorized Interrupt measurement on healthy registered SQL runners, exact persisted-signal attribution, same-session independent-run and foreign-tenant denial controls. Acknowledgement means persisted signal submission, not cancellation completion. Revision 4's failed-snapshot claim was contradicted by pinned Cluster 0.60.5: after release both runs succeed with output 172 and exact once-only business counts; interrupt-to-failed termination remains EVE-54 work. Execution and signed delivery evidence are separately recorded on EVE-35 and in the maintained timeline; full conversation/user-input/approval orchestration and EVE-54 lifecycle acceptance remain open. No production authorization or complete live snapshot refresh is implied. Sources: https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-35#comment-b06cb0d8-09d1-4d31-bdb2-7e75ca7f274e, https://ampcode.com/threads/T-01a1ea29-6178-7380-a38b-2ad341f4da81. 0 prerequisites; 1 unlocks. Layer 0.

a.aria-label: EVE-39: Make every entity action idempotent and persisted by default. UPCOMING. Captured Linear: Backlog. 2026-11-17: later-status: Batch 3 slice 2 preserves the already approved A1/A2 exact-input binding in action preparation only; its prior red/green and signed delivery remain cited. Batch 4 slice 1 implements the approved EVE-40 A3 intent lifetime inside the executor: each policy inspection receives a disposable scalar view, never the decoded intent subsequently enforced. Restoring shared-intent behavior makes 14 of 17 public regressions fail, including deadline-0 deletion incorrectly succeeding; all 17 pass with isolation, and the focused execution/host/action-type suite passes 131 tests. Retained references across integrity waits and replay cannot rewrite timing, schedule, expected state/version or idempotency/approval bindings; live identity, policy and approval revocation remain fresh. Full gates and signed delivery evidence are recorded separately on EVE-39/EVE-40. EVE-39 remains Backlog; EVE-40 was already Done, and neither status is changed. This volatile in-process fixture is not an external exploit, payment, durable SQL/crash proof, production authorization or whole-issue completion. The historical issue capture remains unchanged. Sources: https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-39#comment-7f7ed992-bf10-4c34-9161-7afb155f51fc, https://ampcode.com/threads/T-01a1ea44-9e01-725c-9b01-9126c260a325, https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-39#comment-b29e9dc6-13ad-4601-b816-2775d340b154, https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-40#comment-f520561e-5fa6-4843-b0f3-5e8c70c885f1, https://ampcode.com/threads/T-1d187d8d-5a8e-492a-b9f9-66786c3a790a. 0 prerequisites; 5 unlocks. Layer 0.
